outcome: Use of different labor analgesia methods (neuraxial analgesia, nitrous oxide, non-pharmaceutical analgesia)
cohort: The study included 567,593 vaginal births registered in Finland between January 1, 2007, and December 31, 2019.
finding: Major differences were observed in the use of labor analgesia between Finnish hospital districts, with trends also varying within the same district over the study period.
